name: New Gas-Based Urea Plants: NIPU-2026 Capacity Wave
scope: Cabinet approved NIPU-2026 on 15 Jul 2026 to add ~10 Mt of gas-based urea capacity via 8-9 new 1.27 Mtpa plants (12-16% RoE band, >Rs 250 cr saving per plant vs NIP-2012); Chambal is evaluating a ~Rs 10,000 cr plant and GAIL-RCF signed an MoU (29 Jul 2026) for the first one, but confirmed listed participants are few and mid/large cap and fertiliser stocks are already covered by retail finance media, so this is early on plant awards/EPC but only partly undiscovered.
questions: What does NIPU-2026 provide (RoE band, pricing/subsidy mechanism, gas pooling, plant size, timelines) and how does it differ from NIP-2012?
How big is India's urea import gap and how many of the 8-9 planned plants have identified sponsors so far?
What exactly has Chambal Fertilisers said about its ~1.27 Mtpa urea plant (cost, bid status, board approval timing, 2030 delivery, funding and dividend impact)?
What are the terms of the GAIL-RCF MoU (Vidarbha site, SPV structure, equity split, cost) and what does it mean for each company's capex and earnings?
Which other Indian listed companies (e.g. NFL, Coromandel, GSFC, Deepak, Zuari, Paradeep, Madras Fertilizers) have publicly announced urea plans or proposals under NIPU-2026, with source filings?
Which listed engineering/EPC, technology and equipment suppliers (e.g. Engineers India, Thermax, compressor/pump/pressure-vessel makers) have orders or a credible pipeline from new urea plants?
How have Chambal, RCF and GAIL stocks performed over 6-12 months, and is any re-rating attributable to NIPU-2026? How much broker/media coverage exists?
What happens to Chambal's Gadepan-III benefits ending around Q4 FY27 and how does that interact with the new plant?
Key risks: gas availability and price, subsidy dependence and payment delays, long gestation (~2030), returns dilution, PSU execution delays.
Upcoming catalysts: financial bid evaluation and board approvals, further plant announcements, DoF implementation guidelines, EPC awards.

plant_sponsors: Listed companies that have publicly announced or are evaluating a new NIPU-2026 urea plant
gas_partners: Listed gas suppliers/pipeline owners partnering on new plants
